name: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: Classic 3x3 tic-tac-toe. Two players alternate placing marks; three in a row (row, column, or diagonal) wins.

properties.name: mark
properties.description: The mark this player places (X or O).

actions.name: place_mark
actions.description: Place your mark on an empty cell. Cells are numbered 1-9, top-left to bottom-right.

termination_conditions.name: three_in_a_row
termination_conditions.description: A player completed a row, column, or diagonal.
